question: What destructive power is attributed to the practitioner when angered?
premises: The practitioner is described as angry.
The power to destroy is asserted.
The entire triple world, moving and unmoving, is the scope.
inference: When angered, the practitioner may destroy the entire triple world with all moving and unmoving beings.
plain_english: When angry, he can destroy the whole triple world, with all that moves and does not move.
